shells.description: Asset Administration Shells. Each Group is one AAS - the digital representation of one asset - and holds the Submodels that describe it. The Group id is the symbolic identifier of the AAS Identifiable id

aasidentifier.name: aasidentifier
aasidentifier.description: The AAS Identifiable id as authored, an IRI, IRDI or URN of up to 2048 characters. It is the sole Group source identity and the authority: the shellid is the always-hashed symbolic identifier constructed from it, a one-way construction that is never inverted

idshort.name: idshort
idshort.description: The AAS idShort, a short human-readable name that is unique only within its parent and is therefore never used as an identifier

assetkind.name: assetkind
assetkind.description: The kind of asset this shell represents. Type is a product model, Instance an individual item and Batch a production lot, matching the three granularity levels a product passport is issued at

globalassetid.name: globalassetid
globalassetid.description: The globally unique identifier of the asset itself, as distinct from the shell that describes it. Where the asset carries an identification link this is that link

assettype.name: assettype
assettype.description: The identifier of the asset type this asset is an occurrence of

specificassetids.name: specificassetids
specificassetids.description: Additional domain-specific keys the asset is discoverable by, such as a serial number, a manufacturer part id or a batch id

name.name: name
name.description: The key name, for example serialNumber or manufacturerPartId

externalsubjectid.name: externalsubjectid
externalsubjectid.description: The identifier of the subject this key is disclosed to, so that a registry can restrict which callers see it

derivedfrom.name: derivedfrom
derivedfrom.description: The Type shell this Instance shell was derived from, so that an individual item can be traced to its product model

administration.name: administration
administration.description: The AAS administrative information. It records a single current revision only: the lifecycle history of the shell is carried by xRegistry Versions, which the AAS metamodel has no equivalent of

revision.name: revision
revision.description: The AAS revision label, only meaningful when version is present

templateid.name: templateid
templateid.description: The identifier of the specification template this shell was built from

creator.name: creator
creator.description: The identifier of the party that created this shell

disclosuretier.name: disclosuretier
disclosuretier.description: Whether this entity is readable without authentication or requires an authenticated role. It advertises the tier so a Consumer can discover it; it does not enforce it

authorization.name: authorization
authorization.description: The authorization options a Consumer may use to obtain access to this entity, in the shape defined by the xRegistry Endpoint Registry. It is authorization configuration only and MUST NOT carry credentials

type.name: type
type.description: The authorization type, for example OAuth2, Plain, SASL, X509Cert or APIKey

mechanism.name: mechanism
mechanism.description: The SASL mechanism name, used only when type is SASL

resourceuri.name: resourceuri
resourceuri.description: The URI of the resource authorization is requested for. It is untrusted routing metadata and, if dereferenced, MUST be handled under the resolver egress policy

authorityuri.name: authorityuri
authorityuri.description: The URI of the authority authorization is obtained from. It is untrusted routing metadata and MUST be handled under the resolver egress policy

eventendpoint.name: eventendpoint
eventendpoint.description: The Endpoint Registry entry that delivers change events for this shell, where one is published. It is a URL rather than an xid because the Endpoint Registry serving it is usually a different registry, and an xid is resolved relative to the registry that carries it. It is untrusted routing metadata and MUST be handled under the resolver egress policy

submodels.description: A Submodel served as a document. Every content change creates a new immutable Version, and all Versions are retained and remain directly retrievable. Any core xref target or Resource URL is untrusted routing metadata and MUST be handled under the resolver egress policy

format.name: format
format.description: The serialization format of the document. The AAS-Submodel formats are the Submodel as defined by the AAS metamodel; the EN18223 formats are the product passport serializations derived from it

submodelidentifier.name: submodelidentifier
submodelidentifier.description: The Submodel Identifiable id as authored. It is the sole Resource source identity and the authority: the submodelid is the always-hashed symbolic identifier constructed from it, a one-way construction that is never inverted

semanticid.name: semanticid
semanticid.description: The identifier of the concept this Submodel is an occurrence of, which is what makes a Submodel discoverable by meaning rather than by name

supplementalsemanticids.name: supplementalsemanticids
supplementalsemanticids.description: Further concept identifiers this Submodel corresponds to, used to carry the same meaning across more than one dictionary

kind.name: kind
kind.description: Whether this Submodel carries values for one asset or defines the shape other Submodels are built from

idshort.name: idshort
idshort.description: The AAS idShort, unique only within its parent and therefore never used as an identifier

template.name: template
template.description: The identifier of the Submodel Template this Submodel was built from, as authored. It is an identifier rather than a pointer so that it resolves the same way whether or not this registry also serves the template

digest.name: digest
digest.description: Lower-case hexadecimal digest of the exact document bytes a Consumer retrieves, computed with digestalg

digestalg.name: digestalg
digestalg.description: The algorithm used to compute digest. REQUIRED when digest is present

disclosuretier.name: disclosuretier
disclosuretier.description: Whether this document is readable without authentication or requires an authenticated role. A document is wholly one or the other: a tier boundary that falls between elements inside a document cannot be expressed here

authorization.name: authorization
authorization.description: The authorization options a Consumer may use to obtain access to this document, in the shape defined by the xRegistry Endpoint Registry. It is authorization configuration only and MUST NOT carry credentials

type.name: type
type.description: The authorization type, for example OAuth2, Plain, SASL, X509Cert or APIKey

mechanism.name: mechanism
mechanism.description: The SASL mechanism name, used only when type is SASL

resourceuri.name: resourceuri
resourceuri.description: The URI of the resource authorization is requested for. It is untrusted routing metadata and, if dereferenced, MUST be handled under the resolver egress policy

authorityuri.name: authorityuri
authorityuri.description: The URI of the authority authorization is obtained from. It is untrusted routing metadata and MUST be handled under the resolver egress policy

historypolicy.name: historypolicy
historypolicy.description: The AAS domain retention policy. retain-all means every immutable Version is retained without expiration, remains directly retrievable for the operational lifetime of the registry, and neither the Version nor its owning Resource is destructively deleted

submodeltemplates.description: Submodel Template families. Each Group is one publisher's template namespace and holds the Submodels whose kind is Template. The submodels Resource type is imported from the shells Group so that a template and the Submodels built from it are the same Resource model type

templatenamespace.name: templatenamespace
templatenamespace.description: The publisher's template namespace as authored. It is the sole Group source identity and the authority: the submodeltemplateid is the always-hashed symbolic identifier constructed from it

publisher.name: publisher
publisher.description: The organization that publishes this template family. It is descriptive metadata and is not an identity

conceptdictionaries.description: Concept dictionaries. Each Group is one dictionary whose entries give meaning to the semanticid values used elsewhere in this registry

dictionaryidentifier.name: dictionaryidentifier
dictionaryidentifier.description: The dictionary's identifier as authored. It is the sole Group source identity and the authority: the conceptdictionaryid is the always-hashed symbolic identifier constructed from it

conceptdescriptions.description: A Concept Description served as a document. Every content change creates a new immutable Version, and all Versions are retained and remain directly retrievable. Any core xref target or Resource URL is untrusted routing metadata and MUST be handled under the resolver egress policy

format.name: format
format.description: The serialization format of the document

conceptidentifier.name: conceptidentifier
conceptidentifier.description: The Concept Description Identifiable id as authored, which is the value a semanticid elsewhere in this registry refers to. It is the sole Resource source identity and the authority: the conceptdescriptionid is the always-hashed symbolic identifier constructed from it

idshort.name: idshort
idshort.description: The AAS idShort, unique only within its parent and therefore never used as an identifier

iscaseof.name: iscaseof
iscaseof.description: The identifiers of concepts in other dictionaries this concept corresponds to

historypolicy.name: historypolicy
historypolicy.description: The AAS domain retention policy. retain-all means every immutable Version is retained without expiration, remains directly retrievable for the operational lifetime of the registry, and neither the Version nor its owning Resource is destructively deleted

aasxregistries.description: Package stores. Each Group is one store holding AASX package releases and their separate referrer artifacts, and where that store is an OCI registry the Group is one registry or namespace within it. Defined by the AAS package binding rather than by the AAS registry model

storeidentifier.name: storeidentifier
storeidentifier.description: The stable identifier of the package store or store namespace as authored. It is the sole Group source identity and the authority: the aasxregistryid is the always-hashed symbolic identifier constructed from it

registryurl.name: registryurl
registryurl.description: The current base URL of the backing package store. It is untrusted routing metadata, is not an identity, and MUST be handled under the resolver egress policy, including configured RFC 6052 NAT64-prefix and both ISATAP-marker embedded-IPv4 normalization, unconditional metadata-address denial, and special-use rejection before global acceptance

namespace.name: namespace
namespace.description: The current namespace within the backing store that this Group covers. It is routing metadata and is not an identity

packages.description: An AASX package release served as a document. Every content change creates a new immutable retained Version. In the OCI binding the Version source identity is manifestdigest; tags are mutable aliases in the Resource meta object. OCI referrer manifests MUST NOT be package Versions. Any core xref target or Resource URL is untrusted routing metadata and MUST be handled under the resolver egress policy

format.name: format
format.description: The package format of the document

packageidentifier.name: packageidentifier
packageidentifier.description: The package name as held by the backing store, which for an OCI registry is the repository name. It is the sole Resource source identity and the authority: the packageid is the always-hashed symbolic identifier constructed from it

manifestdigest.name: manifestdigest
manifestdigest.description: The immutable OCI manifest digest, including its algorithm prefix. In the OCI binding this is REQUIRED, is the Version source identity, and the versionid is its always-hashed symbolic identifier. It is distinct from digest, which verifies the returned package blob

artifacttype.name: artifacttype
artifacttype.description: The media type that identifies what this artifact is, carried by the backing store where it supports one

digest.name: digest
digest.description: Lower-case hexadecimal digest of the exact package blob bytes a Consumer retrieves, computed with digestalg. It is distinct from the OCI manifest digest and is the value used to verify the returned document

digestalg.name: digestalg
digestalg.description: The exact algorithm mapped from the OCI package-layer descriptor and used to verify the package blob. A Producer MUST retain the mapped Sha256, Sha384 or Sha512 value and MUST NOT substitute a different algorithm

aasidentifiers.name: aasidentifiers
aasidentifiers.description: The AAS Identifiable ids contained in this package, so a Consumer can tell what a package holds without retrieving and opening it

shell.name: shell
shell.description: The shell this package is the packaged form of, where the same registry also serves it as a Group

historypolicy.name: historypolicy
historypolicy.description: The AAS domain retention policy. retain-all means every immutable Version is retained without expiration, remains directly retrievable for the operational lifetime of the registry, and neither the Version nor its owning Resource is destructively deleted

tags.name: tags
tags.description: The current mutable OCI tag aliases for this repository as lossless entries in the Resource meta object. Each raw tag is a value rather than a map key, and identifies an immutable manifest Version; tags MUST NOT be used as versionids

tag.name: tag
tag.description: The raw OCI tag exactly as held by the registry, preserving case, leading underscore and the full value up to the OCI limit of 128 characters

manifestdigest.name: manifestdigest
manifestdigest.description: The immutable manifest digest to which the raw tag currently points

referrers.description: An immutable OCI referrer artifact such as an attestation. Each referrer manifest is a separate Resource containing exactly one immutable Version, so its arrival cannot affect a package Resource's default Version. The verified manifest subject, artifactType and layer descriptor and the format-specific verified statement subject MUST bind to the selected package manifest. Any core xref target or Resource URL is untrusted routing metadata and MUST be handled under the resolver egress policy

format.name: format
format.description: The opaque attestation or referrer document format

manifestdigest.name: manifestdigest
manifestdigest.description: The immutable OCI referrer manifest digest, including its algorithm prefix, verified against the exact manifest bytes before those bytes are parsed. It is the sole Resource source identity and also the Version source identity and authority: both referrerid and versionid are its always-hashed symbolic identifier

subjectmanifestdigest.name: subjectmanifestdigest
subjectmanifestdigest.description: An index hint copied from the OCI referrer manifest subject digest. It MUST equal the subject digest parsed from the verified referrer manifest, but a Consumer MUST NOT treat this registry value as authority

artifacttype.name: artifacttype
artifacttype.description: The exact OCI artifactType parsed from the verified referrer manifest, identifying what kind of referrer or attestation this is

layermediatype.name: layermediatype
layermediatype.description: The exact mediaType of the single layer descriptor parsed from the verified referrer manifest

signer.name: signer
signer.description: The identifier of the party that produced the attestation, where it is established when the immutable Resource is created

digest.name: digest
digest.description: Lower-case hexadecimal digest of the exact attestation blob bytes a Consumer retrieves. It MUST equal the encoded digest in the single layer descriptor parsed from the verified referrer manifest

digestalg.name: digestalg
digestalg.description: The exact case-sensitive algorithm mapped from the single layer descriptor parsed from the verified referrer manifest and used to verify the attestation blob

historypolicy.name: historypolicy
historypolicy.description: The AAS domain retention policy. retain-all means the immutable referrer Version remains directly retrievable for the operational lifetime of the registry and neither it nor its owning Resource is destructively deleted
